name: RC-B10-0157/2026 – After recital A – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
part_text: Aa. whereas in December 2025, Colombian President Gustavo Petro stated on X that Colombian citizens who were deceived into serving as mercenaries in Ukraine had effectively been kidnapped and held against their will by Ukrainian forces, preventing their departure despite their requests;
